# Castle Garage Doors & Gates

> Veteran-owned, family-operated garage door and gate service company serving San Diego to Riverside County since 1981.

## Business Facts

- Name: Castle Garage Doors & Gates
- Phone: (800) 576-1397
- Email: info@castlegaragedoors.com
- Address: 1291 Simpson Way Suite D, Escondido, CA 92029
- Founded: 1981
- CSLB License: #1154002 (C-61/D-28 — Door Systems)
- Hours: Mon–Thu 6:30 AM–4:30 PM, Fri 7:00 AM–4:30 PM, Sat 8:00 AM–12:00 PM, Sun Closed
- 24/7 Emergency Service Available

## Services

- Garage Door Repair (springs, cables, rollers, panels, tracks, drums, sensors, emergency)
- Garage Door Installation (residential, commercial, custom)
- Garage Door Openers (installation, repair, LiftMaster, smart/WiFi)
- Gate Services (installation, repair, automatic/electric, driveway, security, openers)

## Service Areas

San Diego, Escondido, Oceanside, Carlsbad, Encinitas, Temecula, Murrieta, Fallbrook, Vista, San Marcos, Poway, Corona
